proof_route: Prove canonical Machine.writeAt produces the expected pointwise getD update, ignoring finite-list trailing blanks.

Represent natural register n by bot at zero, ones in cells 1 through n, blank afterward, and head position n. Increment is preserve/right then one/stay; positive decrement is blank/left; zero is detected by bot.
Use a finite six-form source language: halt, jump, inc, dec-zero-or-positive, emit constant bit, read/advance one of four read-only tapes with a four-symbol branch table.

Compile with two banks of L labels plus start/halt/query states via constructive finSumFinEquiv. Ordinary and increment-completion tables only inspect scanned symbols and perform legal one-cell writes/moves.
Prove initialization and each instruction-boundary Represents relation, then exact run simulation at time 1+P.time inp t. Prove P.time inp t <= 2*t.
Prove TapeRep of a finite bit word forces the concrete list to be that word followed by blanks, yielding exact canonical Cfg.output. Use canonical halt absorption to pad to 1+2*t.
Define Exec with only active actual source steps and Stops with a halted endpoint. Relabel actual finite target labels, preserving active traces.
Sequence code tables in a disjoint finite sum: first-fragment halt becomes one jump to the second entry. Prove exact cost t+1+s.

Counted-loop table consists of body labels plus a decrement/branch header and halt exit. Body halts redirect to the header. Fresh forbids writes to the loop counter. Induction on the initial counter proves n*(B+2)+1 using actual verified body executions and an indexed invariant.
